descriptions.rgb: The scene is a compact open kitchen with a long white island in the foreground, counters and cabinets along the rear wall, and a television/storage unit beyond the island toward the left-middle background. In frames 1–4, a woman stands across the island about 1–2 m from the camera wearer, generally near the left or center of view; she faces partly toward the wearer while looking mostly downward or sideways, and holds a red object close to her torso. The island edge, a red placemat, and a small white bowl are within the camera wearer’s arm’s reach, while the woman can reach the opposite side of the island and nearby countertop items; flowers and a fruit plate sit farther along the island, roughly 1–2 m from her. As the camera wearer turns and moves rightward across the five frames, the woman shifts from left-front to center and then farther left/out of view, while more of the stove, sink, refrigerator, and right side of the kitchen become visible. In frame 5, a man appears about 1–2 m ahead with his back to the camera, facing the counter and microwave; he partly occludes the rear counter, while the woman and much of the island are then outside the left edge of view.
